claims.text: Under POL-NS-01 the $4.50 cancellation fee is chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and limbs (b) and (c) are measured on the GPS trace — the driver must be inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius under POL-NS-02 before the arrival marker, and the free waiting period runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap. Nothing else in the bundle supplies those two facts. (EV-GPS-02760 is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.)

trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON for this trip, so POL-NS-12 cannot be used by the driver side: the platform's 'driver arrived' and 'wait timer started' events are the driver's own tap, not an independent full-resolution measurement. POL-NS-12 extends only to a GPS_AUTO marker. The arrival and the 482 second dwell therefore rest on EV-GPS-02760 and nothing else — an impaired artifact (weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW).

EV-GPS-02760 carries a defect that must be disclosed and not argued around: weight_multiplier 0.85 on issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a 60.0 second sampling gap from 12:25:04 to 12:26:04 across which the trace jumps 1.0 km in a straight line, and coverage of only 93.9 per cent. I accept that under POL-NS-08 the gap is short and lies outside the waiting window and so does not itself meet the policy-level impairment test; the trace is nonetheless discounted, and under POL-GEN-02(1) the impairment and the issue code must appear on the face of every claim that leans on it.

POL-NS-02 admits a fix to the arrival test only if it reports horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better, and requires at least three consecutive such fixes inside the radius. The bundle records no horizontal accuracy for any fix, and the record's own integrity note treats a fix with no reported accuracy as of UNKNOWN accuracy that is neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter. The derived qualifying_fix_count of 49 is a code assertion whose filter inputs are not before the judge, so the arrival test should be recorded as unconfirmed rather than proved. (EV-GPS-02760 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.)

The deciding facts — in-geofence arrival and the length of the dwell — are carried by EV-GPS-02760 alone, so POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence in any ruling for the driver at that artifact's weight of 0.85, and POL-GEN-02(3) requires the reasoning to name the artifact, its weight and the issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW and to say whether the finding survives the discount. I ask the judge to state that arithmetic expressly rather than reason as though the trace were complete.

EV-ADVIS-02760-01 is MISSING — no advisory covers the pickup in this window — so it keeps its identifier, has no payload, carries weight 0.0 and can corroborate nothing. Nothing in the bundle independently records conditions on the pickup road, and POL-NS-06(i) cannot be run in the driver's favour on a MISSING advisory. The driver's account that he waited 'past the free period at the pin' therefore stands on the single impaired trace and nothing else.

I do not press the rider's assertion of presence as a ground, because the rider's own track does not support it: 87 rider fixes between 12:25:19 and 12:38:14 sit between 806 and 814 m from the pickup pin, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 against the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. POL-NS-04 is likewise unavailable — the chat log holds a single message, sent by the DRIVER at 12:28:49, with no locating message from the rider in the waiting window, so limbs (a) and (b) cannot be met. (EV-GPS-02760 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.)

I also do not run a POL-NS-06 shortfall argument: the trace shows a single in-geofence run from 12:28:24 to 12:36:26 of 482 seconds, and the derived shortfall is -302 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period carried by trip_record.platform_policy. On the trace as it stands the dwell arithmetic is met, and the rider's case rests entirely on whether that single impaired artifact can establish arrival and dwell at all. (EV-GPS-02760 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.)

If the arrival test is not affirmatively satisfied, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable; on that footing POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund of the cancellation fee, with no driver compensation payable. EV-FARE-02760 shows the cancellation-fee line at $4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the sum the rider asks to have returned is exactly the $4.50 contested — on a rider-filed dispute, the FULL_REFUND that POL-GEN-03 defines as the whole contested amount returned to the filing party.

claims.text: All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on this record, so the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable. Limb (a): EV-TRIP-02760 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:28:24 (driver tapped 'I'm Here'). Limb (b): EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the pickup geofence from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:28:24. Limb (c): the in-geofence dwell runs continuously for 482 seconds from 12:28:24 to 12:36:26 against a free waiting period of 180 seconds read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:36:26 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after that dwell had elapsed. EV-GPS-02760 is impaired at weight 0.85, issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW, a single 60-second pre-wait gap that does not touch the arrival or the dwell run.

The POL-NS-02 arrival test is satisfied with room to spare. EV-GPS-02760 records qualifying_fix_count = 49 in-radius fixes at the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m, on a 10-second sampled trace, far more than the 3 consecutive in-radius fixes the clause requires. EV-GPS-02760 is impaired at 0.85 (GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW), and I disclose that; the impairment is a 60-second gap at 12:25:04-12:26:04, before the arrival marker, and so does not touch any of the 49 qualifying fixes.

POL-NS-03 does not govern this trip. That clause applies only where the driver's stationary fixes lie OUTSIDE the POL-NS-02 arrival radius (but within 400 m of the pin). Here the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius, so the wrong-entrance route is not engaged and the ordinary no-show analysis under POL-NS-01 applies. (EV-GPS-02760, impaired at 0.85, GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a gap outside the arrival window that leaves the in-radius run intact.)

The arrival marker was TRUE, so POL-NS-05 finds nothing to correct. The 'arrived' event at 12:28:24 coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:28:24 (derived.arrival.dwell_start_offset_sec = 0.0), and the driver's fixes show a held position (speed 0.0 kph) rather than motion at or above the 15 kph POL-NS-05 threshold and far inside the 300 m test. The waiting clock therefore starts from the arrival event itself. (EV-GPS-02760 impaired at 0.85, GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW; the gap is outside the waiting window and does not affect this pairing.)

There is no waiting-period shortfall, so the POL-NS-06 refund route cannot operate. The effective in-geofence dwell is 482 seconds against a required 180 seconds, a surplus of 302 seconds (derived.arrival.shortfall_sec = -302.0). POL-NS-06 refunds only where the dwell is SHORTER than the free waiting period; it is not. (EV-GPS-02760 impaired at 0.85, issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW, a short gap outside the waiting window that does not shorten the measured run.)

The rider's own words are 'I was there', but the rider's own track says otherwise. EV-GPS-02760's rider_presence block places every one of the rider's 87 fixes at approximately 806 to 814 m from the pickup pin, with rider_qualifying_fix_count = 0 — never once inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m. The rider was roughly eight hundred metres from the pickup point throughout the waiting window. The rider track is carried by the same artifact, impaired at 0.85 under GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW, which I disclose.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider because limb (a) fails outright. EV-CHAT-02760 holds exactly one message and it is the driver's — 'hi im at the pickup point', sent 12:28:49 and read by the rider at 12:29:29. There is no rider message during the waiting window, so there is no locating or coordinating message to trigger the rider-contact exoneration, and the failure of limb (a) disposes of the clause without reaching limb (b) or (c).

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-02760 derived money.driver_compensation = '3.60', driver_compensation_rate 0.8) — the residual 20 percent being retained as the platform service fee. The driver drove to the pin, held position for the full free period and beyond, and is entitled to that compensation.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so the SGD 3.60 compensation must be paid rather than withheld. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well below the threshold of 4 that the clause requires as the first limb; the absolute-count limb alone fails, and no rate computation can rescue it. Only the two fields the clause names (no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d) may be used for this check.

The charge itself reconciles, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect and no arithmetic basis for any refund. EV-FARE-02760 shows cancellation_fee SGD 4.50, matching trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0. Under POL-GEN-03 the filing rider's claim is unsupported and the present state — the charge standing — is left exactly as it is.

The missing traffic advisory costs this case nothing. EV-ADVIS-02760-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, no advisory covering Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru in this window, and I do not assert the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation route against it. That is correct, because the driver's dwell is a single unbroken 482-second run (derived.arrival.run_count = 1) — there are no separate in-geofence intervals to sum — so the absent advisory plays no part in the arithmetic and cannot trigger POL-NS-09.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your $4.50 no-show fee stands, and none of it is refunded. To the driver: the fee is confirmed and you are paid SGD 3.60.

Why the fee stands. POL-NS-01 needs four things and all four are on this record. (a) EV-TRIP-02760 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 12:28:24. (b) EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius from the first in-geofence fix at 12:28:24 — 49 qualifying in-radius fixes, far more than the three consecutive readings POL-NS-02 requires. (c) the in-geofence dwell runs unbroken for 482 seconds (12:28:24 to 12:36:26) against the 180-second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; the derived shortfall is −302 seconds, so POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing. (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:36:26 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed. The arrival marker was not false: the first in-geofence fix coincides with the tap (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0) with the vehicle stationary, so POL-NS-05 corrects nothing and records no false-arrival referral. POL-NS-03 does not govern, because the driver's stationary fixes sit inside the arrival radius rather than outside it.

Why the rider is not exonerated. POL-NS-04 requires a locating message from the rider in the chat; EV-CHAT-02760 holds exactly one message and it is the driver's ('hi im at the pickup point', 12:28:49), so limb (a) fails and the clause is never reached. The rider's own track does not support the assertion 'I was there': EV-GPS-02760's rider_presence block puts all 87 rider fixes 806–814 m from the pin, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against the 100 m STANDARD radius. Rider presence does not decide the fee, so that is context; it also means the rider's claim is unsupported by the rider's own device.

The impaired trace and its effect. EV-GPS-02760 carries weight_multiplier 0.85 and issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a 60-second sampling gap from 12:25:04 to 12:26:04, 1.0 km apart, before the waiting window, on a 93.9%-coverage trace. Under POL-NS-08(b) a gap must exceed 120 seconds and lie inside the waiting window to be a policy-level impairment; this one does neither, so the trace stays usable for arrival and dwell and the case does not escalate. Because arrival and dwell are carried by this trace alone — the arrival marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not let the platform's own events stand as an independent measurement, and the driver's chat message merely repeats the tap — POL-GEN-02(2) caps my confidence at 0.85. The finding survives the discount: the gap sits before the arrival and cannot shorten the measured 482-second run. I reject the suggestion that the arrival test cannot be run for want of per-fix accuracy figures: the derived geometry is authoritative and reports 49 qualifying in-radius fixes, and the pre-pass accuracy note is not evidence of absence.

The money. POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-02760 derived money.driver_compensation '3.60'). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, so the count limb fails and no rate computation can change it; compensation is paid, not withheld. The ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and per POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries that same SGD 3.60; the rider's charge itself stands. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. The MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02760-01, weight 0.0) plays no part: there is a single unbroken dwell run, so no POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is needed, and the fare line reconciles with platform_policy so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. No referral is produced — the arrival marker was true and the reason code was correctly RIDER_NO_SHOW. Confidence 0.85.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this is a rider-filed dispute over the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-02760. The fee stands and is not refunded; the driver is compensated SGD 3.60.

POL-NS-01 (read with POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05) holds on all four limbs. (a) EV-TRIP-02760 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 12:28:24. (b) EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that time - 49 qualifying in-radius fixes at 10 s cadence, with the first in-geofence fix coinciding with the arrival marker (derived dwell_start_offset_sec = 0.0). (c) The continuous in-geofence dwell is 482 seconds, 12:28:24 to 12:36:26, against the 180-second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 12:36:26 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, after the required dwell had elapsed.

The arrival marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not apply (it covers only GPS_AUTO): the arrival and the dwell rest on EV-GPS-02760. That artifact is down-weighted to 0.85 on issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW - a single 60-second sampling gap from 12:25:04 to 12:26:04, before the arrival and outside the waiting window, with coverage of 93.9 per cent. Under POL-NS-08(b) that gap is too short (60 s, against the 120 s threshold) and too early to be a policy-level impairment, so the trace is not impaired under POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the ruling rests on that artifact and confidence is capped at 0.85, above the 0.70 floor. The finding survives the discount: the gap touches none of the 49 in-radius fixes and does not shorten the dwell run. I do not treat the driver's chat message 'hi im at the pickup point' (EV-CHAT-02760, sent 12:28:49) or the driver's statement 'Waited past the free period at the pin' as independent carriers - both merely restate what the trace already says, so neither lifts the 0.85 cap.

The rider's counter-arguments do not change the outcome. POL-NS-02's 25 m accuracy filter: no fix reports horizontal accuracy, and an accuracy-less fix is neither counted nor excluded by that filter, so the 49 derived qualifying fixes stand and arrival is established. POL-NS-03 is not engaged, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius rather than outside it. POL-NS-05 finds nothing to correct (offset 0.0, held position, speed 0.0 kph). POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall: 482 s against 180 s is a 302 s surplus. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: the chat log holds only the driver's message, so limb (a) fails, and independently the rider track places the rider 806-814 m from the pin with rider_qualifying_fix_count = 0, far outside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius.

The fee therefore stands as it presently is (POL-GEN-03: NO_ACTION on the fee). EV-FARE-02760 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, matching platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.50 fee - SGD 3.60 - the residual 20 per cent retained as the platform service fee; the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the required 4, so the absolute-count limb fails on its own). Because compensation is paid, POL-GEN-03 makes the emitted ruling DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 3.60. The monetary effect is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically. No clause of this policy produces a referral on these facts. This ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the $4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands and is not refunded. The driver arrived and waited as POL-NS-01 requires. EV-TRIP-02760 shows the 'I'm Here' tap at 12:28:24, the free-wait timer starting at 12:28:26, and the driver cancelling at 12:36:26 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (49 qualifying in-radius fixes, so the three-consecutive-fix test of POL-NS-02 is comfortably met) from 12:28:24, and shows him holding position there continuously for 482 seconds, against the 180-second free waiting period carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. Under POL-NS-01(c) that clock runs from the first in-geofence GPS fix, not from the tap (derived dwell_start_offset_sec = 0.0 s), and it exceeds the minimum by 302 seconds.

Your arguments do not open an escape. (1) You say the arrival test cannot be confirmed because the trace reports no horizontal accuracy and the 49 qualifying fixes are a code assertion whose filter inputs are not before the judge. The qualifying-fix geometry is computed for this case and given in the brief; I do not recompute it, and the arrival test is met. (2) POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: limb (a) fails, because the only chat message in EV-CHAT-02760 is the driver's ('hi im at the pickup point', 12:28:49), not a rider locating or coordinating message. (3) POL-NS-05 finds no false marker: the dwell begins within 0.0 s of the arrival tap and the in-geofence fixes record 0 km/h, far below the 15 km/h and 300 m triggers. (4) POL-NS-06 finds no shortfall: 482 s against 180 s is a surplus, not a deficit. (5) POL-NS-03 does not engage, because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it. Your own device track, at 806-814 m from the pin with 0 qualifying fixes inside the 100 m presence radius, is consistent with the no-show; I note it only for that.

What remains of your case is the weight of the trace. EV-GPS-02760 is flagged IMPAIRED by the pre-pass at weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW - a single 60.0 s sampling gap from 12:25:04 to 12:26:04, coverage 93.9%. Under POL-NS-08 that gap is shorter than the 120 s threshold and lies before the waiting window, so it does not impair the trace for policy purposes, does not engage POL-NS-09, and does not cap the outcome at PARTIAL_REFUND. The arrival and the dwell are decided on the trace, at the discounted weight.

To the driver: you are entitled to compensation of SGD 3.60, being 80% of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee in force (trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd; EV-FARE-02760 derived money.driver_compensation = 3.60), the residual 20% being retained as the platform service fee. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check on EV-DPROF-02760 does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the first limb requires, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. Your account that you waited past the free period at the pin sits in the counterparty statement and supports the same finding; it carries no weight_multiplier and so enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the confidence arithmetic.

Confidence: the deciding fact - in-geofence arrival and the length of the dwell - is carried by EV-GPS-02760 at weight 0.85. Neither the trip record's arrival and wait-timer events (a driver-pressed BUTTON marker, which POL-NS-12 expressly does not treat as an independent platform measurement) nor the driver's single chat message supplies that fact independently, so POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at 0.85, and not at the bundle mean. The finding survives the 15% discount because the discount arises from a short gap outside the arrival and dwell window that touches neither the arrival nor the measured run. EV-TRIP-02760, EV-FARE-02760, EV-RPROF-02760 and EV-DPROF-02760 all sit at weight 1.0.

Amount and routing: on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling the two money fields carry the same figure, so amount_sgd = driver_compensation_sgd = SGD 3.60 (POL-GEN-03). The rider's $4.50 fee itself stands, which is the NO_ACTION disposition of the fee that POL-NS-07 describes. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so the ruling executes automatically. No clause produces a referral on these facts.

ledger.claim: Under POL-NS-01 the $4.50 cancellation fee is chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and limbs (b) and (c) are measured on the GPS trace — the driver must be inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius under POL-NS-02 before the arrival marker, and the free waiting period runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap. Nothing else in the bundle supplies those two facts. (EV-GPS-02760 is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.)

trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON for this trip, so POL-NS-12 cannot be used by the driver side: the platform's 'driver arrived' and 'wait timer started' events are the driver's own tap, not an independent full-resolution measurement. POL-NS-12 extends only to a GPS_AUTO marker. The arrival and the 482 second dwell therefore rest on EV-GPS-02760 and nothing else — an impaired artifact (weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW).

EV-GPS-02760 carries a defect that must be disclosed and not argued around: weight_multiplier 0.85 on issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a 60.0 second sampling gap from 12:25:04 to 12:26:04 across which the trace jumps 1.0 km in a straight line, and coverage of only 93.9 per cent. I accept that under POL-NS-08 the gap is short and lies outside the waiting window and so does not itself meet the policy-level impairment test; the trace is nonetheless discounted, and under POL-GEN-02(1) the impairment and the issue code must appear on the face of every claim that leans on it.

POL-NS-02 admits a fix to the arrival test only if it reports horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better, and requires at least three consecutive such fixes inside the radius. The bundle records no horizontal accuracy for any fix, and the record's own integrity note treats a fix with no reported accuracy as of UNKNOWN accuracy that is neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter. The derived qualifying_fix_count of 49 is a code assertion whose filter inputs are not before the judge, so the arrival test should be recorded as unconfirmed rather than proved. (EV-GPS-02760 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.)

The deciding facts — in-geofence arrival and the length of the dwell — are carried by EV-GPS-02760 alone, so POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence in any ruling for the driver at that artifact's weight of 0.85, and POL-GEN-02(3) requires the reasoning to name the artifact, its weight and the issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW and to say whether the finding survives the discount. I ask the judge to state that arithmetic expressly rather than reason as though the trace were complete.

EV-ADVIS-02760-01 is MISSING — no advisory covers the pickup in this window — so it keeps its identifier, has no payload, carries weight 0.0 and can corroborate nothing. Nothing in the bundle independently records conditions on the pickup road, and POL-NS-06(i) cannot be run in the driver's favour on a MISSING advisory. The driver's account that he waited 'past the free period at the pin' therefore stands on the single impaired trace and nothing else.

ledger.claim: I do not press the rider's assertion of presence as a ground, because the rider's own track does not support it: 87 rider fixes between 12:25:19 and 12:38:14 sit between 806 and 814 m from the pickup pin, and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 against the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. POL-NS-04 is likewise unavailable — the chat log holds a single message, sent by the DRIVER at 12:28:49, with no locating message from the rider in the waiting window, so limbs (a) and (b) cannot be met. (EV-GPS-02760 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.)

I also do not run a POL-NS-06 shortfall argument: the trace shows a single in-geofence run from 12:28:24 to 12:36:26 of 482 seconds, and the derived shortfall is -302 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period carried by trip_record.platform_policy. On the trace as it stands the dwell arithmetic is met, and the rider's case rests entirely on whether that single impaired artifact can establish arrival and dwell at all. (EV-GPS-02760 is impaired: weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW.)

If the arrival test is not affirmatively satisfied, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable; on that footing POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund of the cancellation fee, with no driver compensation payable. EV-FARE-02760 shows the cancellation-fee line at $4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the sum the rider asks to have returned is exactly the $4.50 contested — on a rider-filed dispute, the FULL_REFUND that POL-GEN-03 defines as the whole contested amount returned to the filing party.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on this record, so the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is legitimately chargeable. Limb (a): EV-TRIP-02760 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:28:24 (driver tapped 'I'm Here'). Limb (b): EV-GPS-02760 places the driver inside the pickup geofence from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:28:24. Limb (c): the in-geofence dwell runs continuously for 482 seconds from 12:28:24 to 12:36:26 against a free waiting period of 180 seconds read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:36:26 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after that dwell had elapsed. EV-GPS-02760 is impaired at weight 0.85, issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW, a single 60-second pre-wait gap that does not touch the arrival or the dwell run.

The POL-NS-02 arrival test is satisfied with room to spare. EV-GPS-02760 records qualifying_fix_count = 49 in-radius fixes at the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m, on a 10-second sampled trace, far more than the 3 consecutive in-radius fixes the clause requires. EV-GPS-02760 is impaired at 0.85 (GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW), and I disclose that; the impairment is a 60-second gap at 12:25:04-12:26:04, before the arrival marker, and so does not touch any of the 49 qualifying fixes.

POL-NS-03 does not govern this trip. That clause applies only where the driver's stationary fixes lie OUTSIDE the POL-NS-02 arrival radius (but within 400 m of the pin). Here the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius, so the wrong-entrance route is not engaged and the ordinary no-show analysis under POL-NS-01 applies. (EV-GPS-02760, impaired at 0.85, GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW — a gap outside the arrival window that leaves the in-radius run intact.)

The arrival marker was TRUE, so POL-NS-05 finds nothing to correct. The 'arrived' event at 12:28:24 coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:28:24 (derived.arrival.dwell_start_offset_sec = 0.0), and the driver's fixes show a held position (speed 0.0 kph) rather than motion at or above the 15 kph POL-NS-05 threshold and far inside the 300 m test. The waiting clock therefore starts from the arrival event itself. (EV-GPS-02760 impaired at 0.85, GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW; the gap is outside the waiting window and does not affect this pairing.)

There is no waiting-period shortfall, so the POL-NS-06 refund route cannot operate. The effective in-geofence dwell is 482 seconds against a required 180 seconds, a surplus of 302 seconds (derived.arrival.shortfall_sec = -302.0). POL-NS-06 refunds only where the dwell is SHORTER than the free waiting period; it is not. (EV-GPS-02760 impaired at 0.85, issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW, a short gap outside the waiting window that does not shorten the measured run.)

The rider's own words are 'I was there', but the rider's own track says otherwise. EV-GPS-02760's rider_presence block places every one of the rider's 87 fixes at approximately 806 to 814 m from the pickup pin, with rider_qualifying_fix_count = 0 — never once inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m. The rider was roughly eight hundred metres from the pickup point throughout the waiting window. The rider track is carried by the same artifact, impaired at 0.85 under GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW, which I disclose.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider because limb (a) fails outright. EV-CHAT-02760 holds exactly one message and it is the driver's — 'hi im at the pickup point', sent 12:28:49 and read by the rider at 12:29:29. There is no rider message during the waiting window, so there is no locating or coordinating message to trigger the rider-contact exoneration, and the failure of limb (a) disposes of the clause without reaching limb (b) or (c).

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-02760 derived money.driver_compensation = '3.60', driver_compensation_rate 0.8) — the residual 20 percent being retained as the platform service fee. The driver drove to the pin, held position for the full free period and beyond, and is entitled to that compensation.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so the SGD 3.60 compensation must be paid rather than withheld. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well below the threshold of 4 that the clause requires as the first limb; the absolute-count limb alone fails, and no rate computation can rescue it. Only the two fields the clause names (no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d) may be used for this check.

The charge itself reconciles, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect and no arithmetic basis for any refund. EV-FARE-02760 shows cancellation_fee SGD 4.50, matching trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0. Under POL-GEN-03 the filing rider's claim is unsupported and the present state — the charge standing — is left exactly as it is.

The missing traffic advisory costs this case nothing. EV-ADVIS-02760-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, no advisory covering Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru in this window, and I do not assert the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation route against it. That is correct, because the driver's dwell is a single unbroken 482-second run (derived.arrival.run_count = 1) — there are no separate in-geofence intervals to sum — so the absent advisory plays no part in the arithmetic and cannot trigger POL-NS-09.
